# Syrtis v1.1.0

**Syrtis can now download your Cursor usage from the signed-in Cursor app, without the tokscale CLI.** Grok Bot usage that Cursor bills moves from the Cursor tab to Grok Build & Bot, and Cursor usage saved by the current tokscale CLI is now counted.

## Cursor usage sync

- **Turning it on.** When the Cursor app is installed, an Overview card asks once: Continue turns sync on, Turn Off leaves it off. Settings → General → Cursor usage sync has the same switch. Nothing is read or sent until you answer.
- **What it reads, sends and keeps.** Syrtis reads the Cursor app's login on this PC and sends it only to cursor.com's usage service. For each request it keeps the date, model, token counts, cost and conversation ID on this PC, under `%APPDATA%\com.nyanako.tokenbar`, in a folder only your Windows account and SYSTEM can open. The login itself is never saved or logged.
- **When it runs.** At launch, then every 30 minutes, or right away with Sync Now. If the Cursor app has not run for a while its login expires; Syrtis then says so, sends nothing, and resumes once you open Cursor.
- **If you already use tokscale CLI.** Syrtis keeps showing the CLI's Cursor usage and asks in Settings whether to use its own sync instead. Choose that only for the same Cursor account; Keep tokscale CLI Data undoes it.
- **Turning it off** deletes the downloaded usage. If a file can't be deleted, Settings says so, and restarting Syrtis tries again.

Thanks @whes1015.

## Grok Bot usage

- Cursor usage events from Grok Bot (models named `grok-bot…`) now count under **Grok Build & Bot** instead of Cursor, whether they come from this sync or from a tokscale CLI cache. All-time totals don't change. Cursor files are read again once after updating.
- In Usage Attribution, these rows are suggested as Grok Bot's own plan.
- If you have hidden the Cursor tab, Overview now includes Grok Bot usage; hiding Grok Build & Bot hides it.
- With only the Grok Bot app installed (no Cursor app, no tokscale CLI cache), Syrtis shows Grok Bot's quota but not its usage: the usage comes from Cursor, through the Cursor app's login or the CLI's cache.

## Also in this release

- Cursor usage that the current tokscale CLI saves as `usage.json` is now counted; before, only the older `usage.csv` was read.
- **Antigravity:** when agy is signed in to an account you have captured, and agy has not signed in again since, the main Antigravity card is filled from that account's own login and agy is not started; the card reads OAUTH. Otherwise agy runs as before (AGY). With automatic capture on, a new agy sign-in is captured and used again; with it off, capture again by hand.
- **Antigravity:** if the main card fails while agy's current account is a captured account that works, that account's card takes its place instead of an error.
- A card with an error and no windows to show now has just its red line, without empty "No data" rows under it.
- The update dialog's icon is sharp at 100%, 150% and 200% display scale.
